security_justification.audit_integrity: Improves audit integrity by eliminating duplicate entries in CHANGELOG.md and GitHub Release notes, ensuring each change is attributed accurately to its authoring commit without duplication.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: Uses existing workflow GH_TOKEN via Node built-in fetch without modifying permissions, secrets, or credential scopes.
security_justification.authority_provenance: No authority or identity credentials are altered. The cleaner preserves original branch commit hashes and commit author provenance in CHANGELOG.md while eliminating redundant merge commit links.
security_justification.concurrency: Executes synchronously during workflow execution with no concurrent race conditions or asynchronous state sharing.
security_justification.confidentiality: Operates exclusively on public git commit messages, hashes, and public CHANGELOG.md markdown; diagnostics sanitize tokens and headers.
security_justification.cryptography: Does not introduce, alter, or rely upon cryptographic algorithms, keys, or signature verification.
security_justification.error_disclosure: Diagnostics print public commit hashes and changelog subject lines without disclosing internal system paths, environment secrets, or credentials.
security_justification.external_security_integration: Interacts only with the GitHub REST API via standard workflow environment endpoints without third-party external services.
security_justification.fail_posture: Fails closed in both cleaning and check modes on unrecognised entries, unresolvable commits, or REST update errors.
security_justification.lifecycle: Operates during the release PR creation, update, and required check lifecycle, ensuring release PRs carry clean changelogs before merge.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: Mutations are strictly confined to CHANGELOG.md and release PR branch descriptions; no production code, manifests, or version files are modified.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: Does not process user telemetry, personal data, or sensitive operational payloads.
security_justification.resource_retention: Retains no persistent buffers, memory leaks, or open handles beyond process termination.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: Deterministic idempotency; running the cleaner repeatedly on an already cleaned changelog produces identical output with no modifications.
security_justification.trust_boundary: No trust boundary is defined, moved, or crossed. The cleaner operates solely on release changelog markdown text and local git commit graph metadata.
